## Service: companies (Companies API)

Documentation for Companies API

### Get Company
GET /companies/{companyId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/companies/{companyId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/companies/get-company | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/companies/get-company.md

Get Comapny

Auth: Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: companies.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- companyId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT")

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
